subsections: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium

accepted.s: Spitsbergen Island, associated with the Svalbard Global Seed Vault, is located in which country?
accepted.x: Spitsbergen Island is part of the Svalbard archipelago of Norway and hosts the Svalbard Global Seed Vault.
accepted.tq: Use the precise location-country association rather than the broader Arctic region.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following best describes the Svalbard Global Seed Vault?
o: A regional centre for captive breeding of endangered mammals
A laboratory for preserving animal gametes in liquid nitrogen
The world's largest secure seed store and a global safety duplicate
A field gene bank for tropical tree species
accepted.x: The Svalbard Global Seed Vault is the world's largest secure seed store and functions as a global backup or safety duplicate for seed collections.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a seed vault from gene banks, zoos and cryopreservation facilities.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Svalbard Global Seed Vault:
1. It is built inside a mountain in permafrost.
2. It serves as a global safety duplicate of seed collections.
3. India deposits duplicate seed samples there.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The vault is located inside a mountain in permafrost, acts as a global backup and receives duplicate seed samples from India.
accepted.tq: Check all statements against the facility's location, purpose and participation details.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National Gene Bank of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research–National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources was established in which year?
accepted.x: The National Gene Bank at ICAR-NBPGR, New Delhi, was set up in 1996.
accepted.tq: Recall the establishment year from a group of closely spaced institutional dates.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National Gene Bank at ICAR-NBPGR has approximately how many accessions?
accepted.x: The National Gene Bank at ICAR-NBPGR has about 4.7 lakh accessions.
accepted.tq: Separate an existing accession figure from the larger capacity announced for the second gene bank.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the second National Gene Bank announced in the Union Budget 2025–26?
o: It will store 4.7 lakh accessions and function as a marine gene bank.
It will be established at Kew Gardens as a global wild-seed repository.
It will preserve only animal embryos at −196°C.
It will have a capacity of 10 lakh germplasm lines and serve as a safety duplicate.
accepted.x: The second National Gene Bank was announced with a capacity of 10 lakh germplasm lines and is intended to function as a safety duplicate.
accepted.tq: Use the institutional-purpose and capacity distinction to reject swapped facility descriptions.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below:

List-I (Facility)
a. International Rice Genebank
b. National Botanical Research Institute
c. High-altitude seed vault
d. Millennium Seed Bank

List-II (Location)
i. Chang La
 ii. Wakehurst, United Kingdom
 iii. Los Baños, Philippines
 iv. Lucknow

option_a: a–iii, b–iv, c–i, d–ii
option_b: a–iv, b–iii, c–ii, d–i
option_c: a–iii, b–i, c–iv, d–ii
option_d: a–ii, b–iv, c–i, d–iii
accepted.x: The International Rice Genebank is at Los Baños, NBRI is at Lucknow, the high-altitude seed vault is at Chang La and the Millennium Seed Bank is at Wakehurst in the United Kingdom.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure location pair and eliminate codes containing a repeated or misplaced association.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The field gene bank of the National Botanical Research Institute is located at which research station?
accepted.x: The Banthara research station of NBRI holds a field gene bank.
accepted.tq: Test the specific sub-location rather than the headquarters of the institution.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about seed-storage facilities:
1. The Chang La seed vault is situated in Ladakh.
2. It is associated with DRDO and NBPGR.
3. It is located at an altitude of approximately 17,300 feet.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Chang La seed vault is in Ladakh, is associated with DRDO and NBPGR, and is situated at about 17,300 feet.
accepted.tq: Combine location, institutional association and numerical altitude in one statement set.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is described as the largest store of wild plant seeds?
accepted.x: The Millennium Seed Bank at Kew's Wakehurst is described as the largest store of wild plant seeds.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the world's largest secure seed store from the largest store specifically of wild plant seeds.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The stated capacity of the Svalbard Global Seed Vault is approximately:
accepted.x: The Svalbard Global Seed Vault has a stated capacity of approximately 4.5 million seed samples.
accepted.tq: Convert lakh and million figures carefully while distinguishing capacity from present holdings.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT an ex-situ conservation method listed for biological resources?
o: Protection of species within their natural habitat
accepted.x: Protection within the natural habitat is in-situ conservation. Long-term captive breeding, tissue culture banks and in-vitro fertilisation are ex-situ methods.
accepted.tq: Find the option that belongs to the contrasting conservation category.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
A person seeking examples of ex-situ conservation would correctly include which of the following?
1. Gene banks
2. Botanical gardens
3. Zoos
4. Translocation
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Gene banks, botanical gardens, zoos and translocation are all included among the ex-situ methods listed.
accepted.tq: Recognise the complete set of related conservation methods instead of selecting only storage facilities.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs of zoological parks in Andhra Pradesh is correctly matched?
o: Indira Gandhi Zoological Park — Visakhapatnam; Sri Venkateswara Zoological Park — Tirupati
Indira Gandhi Zoological Park — Tirupati; Sri Venkateswara Zoological Park — Visakhapatnam
Indira Gandhi Zoological Park — Kakinada; Sri Venkateswara Zoological Park — Vijayawada
Indira Gandhi Zoological Park — Amaravati; Sri Venkateswara Zoological Park — Nellore
accepted.x: The Indira Gandhi Zoological Park is at Visakhapatnam and Sri Venkateswara Zoological Park is at Tirupati.
accepted.tq: Match each facility with its exact city before considering the combined option.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Indira Gandhi Zoological Park and Sri Venkateswara Zoological Park in Andhra Pradesh are run by which authority?
o: Andhra Pradesh State Biodiversity Board בלבד
Central Zoo Authority of India alone
accepted.x: Both zoological parks are run by the Zoo Authority of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who administers the facility?’ institutional-authority test.
accepted.sec: Ex-situ facilities - locations, cryopreservation and its medium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: India has identified how many Important Coastal and Marine Biodiversity Areas (ICMBAs)?
accepted.x: India has identified 106 Important Coastal and Marine Biodiversity Areas.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact count while rejecting nearby numerical distractors.
accepted.sec: Marine conservation - ICMBAs, Hope Spots, NCMB, marine protected areas  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with respect to marine protected areas in India?
o: Gulf of Kachchh Marine National Park — India's first marine national park
Gulf of Mannar Marine National Park — India's first marine national park
Malvan Marine Sanctuary — India's first marine biosphere reserve
Palk Bay — India's first marine national park
accepted.x: The Gulf of Kachchh Marine National Park is India's first marine national park. Gulf of Mannar is India's first marine biosphere reserve, while Palk Bay is a dugong conservation reserve.
accepted.tq: Separate the distinctions among the first marine national park, first marine biosphere reserve and dugong reserve.
accepted.sec: Marine conservation - ICMBAs, Hope Spots, NCMB, marine protected areas  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Gulf of Mannar is significant in marine conservation because it is:
accepted.x: The Gulf of Mannar is India's first Marine Biosphere Reserve.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the officially recognised first of one protected-area category from other marine designations.
accepted.sec: Marine conservation - ICMBAs, Hope Spots, NCMB, marine protected areas  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Successful coral restoration associated with the Gulf of Mannar Marine Biosphere Reserve has been reported at:
accepted.x: Successful coral restoration in the Gulf of Mannar Marine Biosphere Reserve has been associated with Vaan Island.
accepted.tq: Link the conservation intervention with its specific site rather than the larger reserve.
accepted.sec: Marine conservation - ICMBAs, Hope Spots, NCMB, marine protected areas  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Palk Bay, covering approximately 448 square kilometres, has been designated as India's first:
o: Important Coastal and Marine Biodiversity Area
accepted.x: Palk Bay, covering about 448 square kilometres, is India's first Dugong Conservation Reserve.
accepted.tq: Use the area figure to identify the correct protected-area designation.
accepted.sec: Marine conservation - ICMBAs, Hope Spots, NCMB, marine protected areas  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Hope Spots are ocean areas identified as critical to ocean health by:
o: The Zoo Authority of Andhra Pradesh
Mission Blue, associated with Sylvia Earle
UNESCO's Man and the Biosphere Programme
accepted.x: Hope Spots are ocean sites named by Mission Blue, an initiative associated with marine scientist Sylvia Earle, because of their importance to ocean health.
accepted.tq: Identify the responsible organisation and associated personality in a conservation initiative.
accepted.sec: Marine conservation - ICMBAs, Hope Spots, NCMB, marine protected areas  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following Indian regions are identified as Hope Spots?
1. Lakshadweep
2. Andaman and Nicobar Islands
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Both Lakshadweep and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands are identified as Indian Hope Spots.
accepted.tq: Test paired geographical examples without confusing Hope Spots with marine national parks.
accepted.sec: Marine conservation - ICMBAs, Hope Spots, NCMB, marine protected areas  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about global ocean protection:
1. About 10 per cent of the ocean is protected.
2. Only 1.66 per cent of the high seas is protected.
3. Only about 3 per cent of the ocean is fully or highly protected.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements reflect the stated global figures: about 10 per cent of the ocean is protected, 1.66 per cent of the high seas is protected and about 3 per cent is fully or highly protected.
accepted.tq: Check each percentage independently because the figures refer to different levels of protection.
accepted.sec: Marine conservation - ICMBAs, Hope Spots, NCMB, marine protected areas  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The global area of marine protection must approximately be increased by how much by 2030 to meet the 30x30 goal?
accepted.x: Marine protection must triple by 2030 to meet the 30x30 goal.
accepted.tq: Connect the target year and conservation multiplier with the stated global goal.
accepted.sec: Marine conservation - ICMBAs, Hope Spots, NCMB, marine protected areas  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the Andhra Pradesh priorities and institutional initiatives related to marine conservation?
o: APSES lists captive breeding under SDG 14, while APSBB plans a zoological park framework.
APSES lists desertification control under SDG 14, while APSBB plans a cryopreservation framework.
APSES lists expansion of marine protected areas under SDG 14, while APSBB plans a Marine ABS framework.
APSES lists seed-vault expansion under SDG 14, while APSBB plans a mountain biodiversity framework.
accepted.x: Under SDG 14, APSES identifies expansion of marine protected areas as a priority, and APSBB plans a Marine Access and Benefit-Sharing framework.
accepted.tq: Match each organisation with its correct marine-conservation priority or framework.
accepted.sec: Marine conservation - ICMBAs, Hope Spots, NCMB, marine protected areas  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched with a marine conservation site or category?
o: Palk Bay — India's first marine biosphere reserve
Gulf of Mannar Marine National Park — Marine protected area
Malvan Marine Sanctuary — Marine protected area
Gulf of Kachchh Marine National Park — India's first marine national park
accepted.x: Palk Bay is India's first Dugong Conservation Reserve, not India's first marine biosphere reserve. The Gulf of Mannar is India's first Marine Biosphere Reserve.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped designation among closely related marine conservation categories.
accepted.sec: Marine conservation - ICMBAs, Hope Spots, NCMB, marine protected areas  [APPSC]
